summary: Frontend-only verification of NO AUTO-SHIFT revert (Sertex HUD panels). All 6 acceptance categories PASS. (1) NO AUTO-SHIFT ON HIDE/RESTORE: SERTEX·SİSTEM rect stayed at (16,16,300x250) after hiding ZAMAN·HAVA and after restoring it — no y-shift, no x-shift. (2) MANUAL DRAG PERSISTS: drag via .panel-drag-topleft persisted to localStorage sertex_windows_v1.topleft = {x:350, y:287, dock:'free', ...}; after full page reload panel re-appeared at exact same (350,287) — persistence works end-to-end. (3) OVERLAP ALLOWED: dragged SERTEX·SİSTEM and NEURAL CORE both to (~100,100) — both ended overlapping at (0,87), no auto-shift, no toast/warning, no sonner error surface. (4) SIDEBAR BOUNDS RESPECTED: with sidebar docked SAĞ (right, w=440), attempted drag to x=1900 — panel.right stayed at 300 ≤ 1480 (well inside hud-bounds). (5) CHIP z-index=45: after hiding hud-top-left, chip rendered inside #chip-stack-left with computed zIndex='45', position='fixed', visible=true — above panel z-30 as spec. (6) REGRESSION ALL PASS: SIFIRLA restored top-left to (16,16); dock-cycle SAĞ→ALT→…→SAĞ works; GİZLE hides all panels and restores them; palette pink→#f472b6 persisted; panel dock=left persisted then reverted to free; Weather (Open-Meteo, İstanbul) shows real data '31.8°C · Parçalı Bulutlu'; DÜZEN preset save/select-load(with reload)/delete cycle succeeded (TEST_layout created, applied, then deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: DraggablePanel.jsx: auto-clamp block cleanly removed as spec'd (comment at lines 120-123 documents the intentional removal). Rnd uses pos/size directly and only bounds='#hud-bounds' applies during active drag — matches Serkan's request that overlap resolution be manual.

Sidebar.jsx boundsStyle (lines 367-382) no longer consumes --sx-chip-top/--sx-chip-bottom vars — hud-bounds now only shrinks by the sidebar's own width/height. Chip stacks (still tracked via ResizeObserver in SertexMain.jsx per instructions) simply overlay at z-45 above panels z-30, which is correct.

Minor: DraggablePanel.jsx line 407-408 still uses window.innerWidth/innerHeight at render time without a resize listener → maxWidth/maxHeight not recomputed on viewport resize (pre-existing, non-blocking, also noted in iteration_19/20).

Minor: The now-removed `sertex:clamp-panels` custom event is still dispatched from Sidebar.jsx cycleDock (line 158-160) and open/dock/dims effect (line 293-298) but no listener exists in DraggablePanel any more. Dead event — harmless but should be removed for clarity.
Minor code hygiene: DraggablePanel.jsx accepts `defaultPos` object but only reads `.x` and `.y`; consider destructuring for readability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Revert of auto-shift/auto-clamp is complete and correct per Serkan's Turkish request. Key contract: DraggablePanel does NOT reposition panels on any external event (hide, restore, sidebar dock change, chip-stack height changes) — user must manually drag. sidebar-toggle-all-panels and sidebar-reset-panels are the ONLY things that mutate panel state. Chip z-index is on the #chip-stack-{left|right|top|bottom} container (z-45), not the chip button itself (button has z=auto). If retesting after any change: also verify weather-summary, weather-sunrise, weather-sunset elements render real Open-Meteo data (backend proxies open-meteo). Preset load triggers a full window.location.reload — must await login + dismiss overdue modal after preset apply. Key testids used: hud-top-left, hud-top-right, hud-bottom-left, hud-top-left-hide, hud-top-right-hide, hud-top-left-restore, hud-top-left-palette (+ -palette-popover + -color-{pink}), hud-top-left-dock (+ -dock-popover + -dock-{left|free}), sidebar-toggle, sidebar-dock-cycle, sidebar-reset-panels, sidebar-toggle-all-panels, sidebar-preset-select, sidebar-preset-save, sidebar-preset-delete, weather-summary. Drag handles use CSS class .panel-drag-{topleft|topright|bottomleft}.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature-revert verification, not a bug fix. Mechanism: prior iteration added an auto-clamp effect in DraggablePanel that re-evaluated pos against hud-bounds whenever the bounds div changed size (e.g., chip stack height CSS var --sx-chip-top). Serkan explicitly requested manual-only ordering. The current DraggablePanel.jsx has that effect deleted (lines 120-123 replaced with an explanatory comment); Rnd binds directly to state pos/size, and bounds='#hud-bounds' still applies during active drag (so panels can't be dragged behind the sidebar). Sidebar.jsx boundsStyle removed the --sx-chip-* subtraction — hud-bounds only shrinks by sidebar occupancy, not by chip-stack height. Chip stacks (rendered by SertexMain.jsx) sit at z-45 above panels z-30 so hidden-chip visibility is guaranteed regardless of overlap.
